thread.title: Apple Inc. Forecasted to Earn Q3 2019 Earnings of $2.19 Per Share (AAPL)

author: Joseph Griffin
title: Apple Inc. Forecasted to Earn Q3 2019 Earnings of $2.19 Per Share (AAPL)
text:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities research analysts at Wedbush decreased their Q3 2019 earnings per share estimates for shares of Apple in a note issued to investors on Wednesday, January 30th. Wedbush analyst D. Ives now expects that the iPhone maker will post earnings of $2.19 per share for the quarter, down from their previous estimate of $2.38. Wedbush currently has a “Outperform” rating and a $200.00 target price on the stock. Wedbush also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2019 earnings at $2.73 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $11.61 EPS, Q1 2020 earnings at $4.49 EPS, Q2 2020 earnings at $2.88 EPS, Q3 2020 earnings at $2.55 EPS and Q4 2020 earnings at $3.16 EPS.
Get Apple alerts: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. The business had revenue of $84.31 billion during analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. Apple 51.09% and a net margin of 22.72%.
Several other research firms have also commented on AAPL. Vertical Group began coverage on Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. They issued a “sell” rating for the company. Bank of America reissued a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. Citigroup boosted their price target on Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 8th. UBS Group set a $250.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 8th. Finally, JPMorgan Chase & Co. reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 10th. Three sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. Apple has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $191.66.
AAPL opened at $166.52 on Thursday. The firm has a market capitalization of $812.23 billion, a PE ratio of 13.98, a P/E/G ratio of 1.61 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. Apple has a 12 month low of $142.00 and a 12 month high of $233.47.

About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
